name: viper-indexer
_overrides_comment: Transitive-only security bumps. Nothing above changes: express stays
^4.21.2 and viper-contracts stays at its pinned commit; these force the
patched versions of packages those two pull in.
bn.js is scoped to ethjs-unit and number-to-bn deliberately. A bare
'bn.js': '4.12.3' also drags web3-utils down from the ^5.2.1 it declares,
which npm applies without complaint -- the hoisted 5.2.5 disappears and
web3-utils gets a 4.x it was never written against.
